tasks.short: Create and verify robot program backups

steps.what: Identify the actual robot, controller revision and final programs/parameters requiring backup
inputs: actual robot/controller identity and current program/parameter set
actual backup scope and permitted storage policy
outputs: engineer-selected exact final source revision and backup scope

steps.what: Prepare and check the final backup source selection, export options, robot identity, file name and permitted destination in robot controller programming/backup software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-selected exact final source revision and backup scope
actual permitted storage destination and export options
outputs: checked exact final program/parameter selection, export configuration and backup destination

steps.what: Create back-ups of the exact checked robot programs or parameters by committing the native export to the checked destination
inputs: checked exact final program/parameter selection, export configuration and backup destination
outputs: actual exported robot backup file

steps.what: Verify the actual backup file exists, opens in the native offline tool and matches the intended robot, revision, program and parameter contents
inputs: actual exported robot backup file
engineer-selected exact final source revision and backup scope
outputs: engineer-verified actual readable backup or identified failure requiring repeat

tasks.design: Configure reusable export selections and native offline comparison views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the robot controller programming/backup system. The engineer checks the exact final source and destination, commits the export, then verifies the actual resulting file without restoring it to a live robot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated export setup and offline content navigation add backup handling effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native backup presets and offline content comparison can reduce repeated setup and navigation.
tasks.still_hard: A created file may not contain the intended complete robot state.
tasks.human_edge: Choose correct scope and recognise a partial or incompatible backup.

ambition.what: No autonomous backup commit or live restore.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; robot and storage owners validate scopes and destinations

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: robot programming tools can provide native export selections and offline inspection; engineers must verify actual backup scope and compatibility.

assumptions: Unmeasured verified-backup episode. Gross 19 x .20 + 60 x .10 = 9.8; upkeep 2; net 7.8 hours per 100.
The real source program/parameter set already exists and is selected/checked in s1-s2. Missing scope information or changed controller versions require manual handling, not inferred completeness.
Preset preparation and offline comparison navigation are the only proposed savings. Actual export/save click is approximately zero today: 1 fully retained point, no saving; export runtime earns none.

s2 checks the final existing source contents, export options and exact destination before s3. Source/configuration/destination changes void that check; resulting-file verification remains after creation in s4.
This is a backup, not a live robot restore or program change. No additional inventory record, upload or notification is promised.
unknowns: Current native presets and actual content-verification burden
research_questions: What is actually selected and verified today, and can native presets preserve all required parameter/program content?

already_counted.description: Source identification, final export-configuration checking and actual resulting-file verification

incremental.description: Maintain export presets and revalidate offline comparison after controller changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact final existing program/parameter set, export options and destination checked in s2; any change requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 setup/verification-navigation scenario below 7.8% modeled net; no saving on backup write or software runtime.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the actual robotic-system symptom, operating context and support request with the operator
inputs: actual operator report and robot identity
actual support authority and operating restrictions
outputs: engineer-clarified support issue and boundaries

steps.what: Find and inspect actual robot alarm history, current configuration and relevant instructions in robot diagnostic/document software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-clarified support issue and boundaries
actual available robot diagnostic records and current manuals
outputs: engineer-read diagnostic evidence and applicable instructions

steps.what: Diagnose the actual robotic-system issue, distinguish evidence from hypotheses and choose appropriate advice or escalation
inputs: engineer-read diagnostic evidence and applicable instructions
actual operator account and support boundaries
outputs: engineer's supported diagnosis, advice and unresolved uncertainties

steps.what: Provide technical support for robotic systems through live explanation, clarification and agreement on safe next steps with the operator
inputs: engineer's supported diagnosis, advice and unresolved uncertainties
actual operator questions and understanding
outputs: actual support guidance and agreed next steps

steps.what: Enter and check the actual technical-support case findings, advice, unresolved issues and intended ticket
inputs: actual support guidance and agreed next steps
engineer's supported diagnosis, advice and unresolved uncertainties
actual ticket and robot identifiers
outputs: exact checked support update and intended ticket

steps.what: Save the exact checked support update to its intended internal ticket
inputs: exact checked support update and intended ticket
outputs: saved internal robotic-system support record

tasks.design: Configure current diagnostic/manual links in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the robot diagnostic/document system, and fixed ticket/robot identifiers in {HELPDESK}. The engineer clarifies and diagnoses the issue, provides live support and checks the actual case update before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current evidence and re-entering case identifiers add support administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered diagnostic views and ticket-context fields can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Symptoms can have multiple physical causes and advice must fit actual operating conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Ask diagnostic questions and recognise when on-site work or escalation is required.

ambition.what: No autonomous robot control or remote parameter change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; support and robot owners approve read-only diagnostics and case access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native diagnostic views and ticket context can reduce support navigation while fault diagnosis and operator guidance remain human.

assumptions: Unmeasured documented support-call episode. Gross 20 x .15 + 9 x .10 = 3.9; upkeep 1; net 2.9 hours per 100.

Actual operator account is elicited in s1 and actual case content entered in s5. Existing robot logs have their actual equipment producer; unavailable logs require manual observation, not a free new data pipeline.
Only navigation and fixed identifiers change. Substantive case writing, diagnosis and live advice remain; no automatic message, escalation ticket or robot action is promised.
Same-system save 1 stays fully retained and earns no saving. Final completed case check s5 gates exact ticket/content; edits require recheck.
unknowns: Actual existing diagnostic links and ticket entry burden
research_questions: Which support lookups and fixed identifiers are actually repeated?

already_counted.description: Intake, diagnosis, live guidance and actual case update/check

incremental.description: Maintain current diagnostic links and ticket-context mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed support update and intended ticket checked in s5; edits invalidate check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 native navigation scenario below 2.9% modeled net; physical diagnosis and conversation retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish actual workpiece, payload, robot interface, reach and handling requirements for end-of-arm tooling
inputs: actual workpieces and required manipulation
actual robot flange, payload and operating envelope
outputs: engineer-defined tooling requirements and physical interfaces

steps.what: Design end-of-arm tooling, selecting gripping, actuation, compliance and retention arrangements
inputs: engineer-defined tooling requirements and physical interfaces
actual workpiece variability and operating constraints
outputs: engineer-selected tooling concept, loads and critical features

steps.what: Author actual end-of-arm tooling CAD model and drawings in mechanical design software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-selected tooling concept, loads and critical features
engineer-entered actual dimensions, materials and interface properties
outputs: complete tooling model and drawing draft

steps.what: Check completed tooling design against loads, gripping/retention, robot interfaces, clearances and intended internal revision
inputs: complete tooling model and drawing draft
actual handling requirements, loads and robot interfaces
outputs: exact checked final tooling design and internal revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked end-of-arm tooling design as its intended internal revision
inputs: exact checked final tooling design and internal revision destination
outputs: saved internal end-of-arm tooling design

tasks.design: Configure native robot-flange/component geometry and drawing templates in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the mechanical design system. The engineer studies actual workpieces, designs gripping and retention, enters real dimensions and checks the complete tooling design before saving its internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated interface geometry and drawing layout add drafting effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native component and drawing reuse can reduce repeated model construction.
tasks.still_hard: Workpiece variation, loads and loss of grip require real design judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Choose tooling that handles the actual workpiece and failure conditions.

ambition.what: No automatic fabrication or robot installation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; tooling/CAD owners validate interface models and access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD component reuse can reduce repeated tooling drafting while gripping, load and clearance choices remain engineering work.

assumptions: Unmeasured repeated tooling-drafting scenario. Gross 30 x .15 = 4.5; upkeep 1.5; net 3 hours per 100.
Engineer produces actual workpiece/interface measurements and dimensions in s1-s3. No free digital workpiece or automatically inferred gripping loads.
Existing CAD computation already occurs today; only repeated geometry/layout changes. No physical tooling test, installation or fabrication release is promised by this design-only proposal.
Same-system save 1 is fully retained with no saving. s4 checks final complete design and revision destination; edits require renewed checking.
unknowns: Reusable geometry beyond current CAD libraries
research_questions: Which robot interface and drawing operations are still repeated manually?

already_counted.description: Actual requirements, tooling concept and completed design verification

incremental.description: Maintain and validate native flange/component geometry and drawings

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed tooling design and internal destination checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 drafting scenario below 3% modeled net; no physical installation gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design robotic platforms and sensing architecture

steps.what: Define actual robotic-platform mission, environment, operator interactions and performance/interface constraints
inputs: actual robotic application and operating environment
actual platform, sensing, control and operator requirements
outputs: engineer-defined robotic-system requirements and assumptions

steps.what: Design robotic systems, selecting robotic platform, advanced sensing, computer-vision/control interfaces and fault behavior for the actual application
inputs: engineer-defined robotic-system requirements and assumptions
actual component capabilities and environmental limitations
outputs: engineer-selected robotic-system architecture and justified interfaces

steps.what: Author actual robotic-system model, interfaces and design description in robotics engineering model/document software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-selected robotic-system architecture and justified interfaces
engineer-entered actual component identities and interface properties
outputs: complete robotic-system model and design description

steps.what: Check the complete robotic-system design, assumptions, interfaces and fault behavior against actual requirements and intended internal revision
inputs: complete robotic-system model and design description
actual application requirements and component/environment evidence
outputs: exact checked final robotic-system design and destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked robotic-system design as its intended internal revision
inputs: exact checked final robotic-system design and destination
outputs: saved internal robotic-system design

tasks.design: For the robotic-platform/sensing design route, configure native fixed component and interface property reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the robotics engineering model/document system. The engineer defines the mission, chooses architecture and behavior, authors the actual design and checks the complete internal revision before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated component/interface entry adds clerical work to architecture documentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native engineering libraries can reuse verified fixed component properties.
tasks.still_hard: Environment uncertainty, sensing limitations and fault behavior determine the viability of the architecture.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a robotic approach suited to real operating conditions and human interaction.

ambition.what: No autonomous vehicle deployment or claim that architecture is validated by documentation alone.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; robotics design owner validates property reuse and access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native robotics engineering libraries can reduce fixed property entry while architecture and application validity remain engineering judgments.

assumptions: Unmeasured platform/sensing architecture episode, one subset of the stated examples. Gross 19 x .10 = 1.9; upkeep .75; net 1.15 hours per 100.
Engineer produces actual mission assumptions, component choices and interface definitions in s1-s3. No free structured environment model or inferred component compatibility.

Only fixed property entry changes; native computation and existing libraries already used today earn no additional saving. No control download, operational test or autonomous vehicle action is proposed.
Same-system save 1 earns no saving and remains fully retained. Final complete-design check s4 gates exact version/destination; edits require recheck.
unknowns: Existing fixed property reuse and model-authoring effort
research_questions: Which fixed component properties are currently retyped rather than already linked?

already_counted.description: Mission definition, architecture choices and completed design verification

incremental.description: Maintain and spot-check native component/interface properties

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed robotic-system design and internal destination checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 fixed-entry scenario below 1.15% modeled net; architecture and physical behavior remain human responsibilities.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Mechanical and robotics engineering design owners
skills_to_grow: Verify actual backup scope and readability
Validate reusable component interfaces against real physical requirements
role.ambitious_version: Use well-tested native backup, diagnostic and design views to reduce repeated record handling while engineers retain physical diagnosis, robot architecture and action authority.
